frozenDecisions.statement: project/PROJECT_STATE.json is the single canonical project steering source; overnight session state remains runtime bookkeeping only.
Push, production deployment, real outreach, real message sending, and paid APIs require separate explicit authorization.
Project steering never overrides runtime safety or provider configuration and must fail closed on conflict.
Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN or UNRESOLVED and cannot satisfy DONE criteria.

The additional H3 channel is PHONE and the implementation role is BUILDER. PHONE may consume only H2.5-trusted phone evidence and may produce only human-initiated call preparation. A phone number never implies WHATSAPP. SMS, social DMs, forms, automatic dialing, automatic sending, outreach execution, deployment, paid APIs, research job consumption, unrelated UI redesign, and H4 are excluded.

The approved H4 contract is Fail-Closed Operator Contactability Projection. The Deck may declare PRÃŠT Ã€ CONTACTER only from a structurally valid, identity-bound H3 EMAIL_DRAFT or PHONE_CALL_PREPARATION. Preparation must belong to the same prospect and its channel must match usable PUBLISHED_VERIFIED contactability. PHONE additionally requires matching contactId and evidenceEventId, a public sourceUrl, requiresHumanDial true, and dialsAutomatically false. EMAIL retains human-send-only behavior and is preferred when both channels coexist. DO_NOT_CONTACT, OPPOSED, malformed, mismatched, missing, or automatic preparation yields no actionable contact control. BUILDER scope is limited to apps/control-center/lib/api.ts, apps/control-center/lib/api.test.ts, apps/control-center/components/ProspectPipeline.tsx, and apps/control-center/components/ProspectPipeline.test.tsx. Sending email, dialing, tel links, inferring WhatsApp or SMS, outreach execution, lifecycle mutation, changes to H1, H2, H2.5, or H3, unrelated UI redesign, and any runtime communication capability are excluded.

blockers.summary: Resolved by the explicit human decision selecting PHONE and by the verified H2.5 trustedPhone boundary, which permits a deterministic second-channel mission without additional product requirements.
The human-approved fail-closed H4 contract, four-file BUILDER scope, DONE criteria, and exclusions are recorded canonically.

V1 evidence-contract mismatch: the Evidence Integrity Gate requires source-supported claims for commercialStrength, contactability, localFit, prototypeLeverage, and digitalGap. The current Research Swarm produces factual source annotations (activity, website, phone, digitalGap) but does NOT produce source annotations for commercialStrength, contactability, localFit, or prototypeLeverage. Consequence: both executed PILOT-01 canaries (including a HIGH_PRIORITY prospect with valid SIRET and official website) were deterministically DISQUALIFIED before operator projection. Canary 3 NO_GO: no remaining DISCOVERED candidate had materially stronger evidence surface. Positive-path qualification is practically unreachable for typical target businesses under the current evidence-integrity contract. Fix must preserve fail-closed semantics â€” do NOT weaken the gate. RESOLVED by EVIDENCE-CONTRACT-ALIGNMENT: added deterministic deriveEvidenceClaims fed through a derivedClaims parameter into evaluateResearchEvidenceIntegrity so that source-backed facts (valid SIREN/SIRET, official website with navigation, phone from official contact page, source-backed activity claim, primary friction) legitimately support contactability/localFit/prototypeLeverage/commercialStrength/digitalGap; phone evidence contract fixed via source-note injection; siteStatus added for UNDER_CONSTRUCTION/REBUILDING signals. Tightened per final acceptance review: commercialStrength now requires a source-backed activity claim (not merely an activity string) + SIRET + website; localFit now requires non-REJECT commercialEligibility + location string (not merely SIREN/SIRET/city); PARKED/DOMAIN_FOR_SALE/UNREACHABLE do NOT get the rebuild boost. Fail-closed semantics preserved: claims without traceable sources or deterministic derivation remain rejected (core 208/208 PASS). Positive-path reachability proven for the tightened rules (Athena-style test with supported activity, PARKED/for-sale negative tests).
